editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in a place where you do not know anyone and everything starts going wrong. You follow a small group of people who are just trying to survive a night that feels like it will never end. The vibe is very tense from the start, and you can feel the fear as the characters realize they are not alone. It feels like a scary road trip gone wrong, where every shadow seems to move and every sound makes you jump. You will find yourself rooting for the survivors even when they make mistakes, because the danger around them is just that scary.

What really makes this work is how the mystery unfolds slowly. The acting feels real, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts of the story drag a bit, the action scenes make up for it. If you love a good scare, you should definitely watch this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that the strangers were lured there as part of a sick game. The main character discovers a hidden room with files on everyone, revealing that their pasts are all linked. After a big fight in the dark, only two people make it out alive. They escape just as the sun rises, but the final shot shows that the people running the game are already picking new targets for next year.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and twisty mysteries.
